focus: Close the charter loop inside the application: the operator adds an ecommerce site by URL in the dashboard, the platform runs the inspection, and an executive report is generated from the Inspection Report without re-inspecting the site.
reason_generation_started: Ferosh chose application-generated executive reports as the next slice and asked to close the full cycle, noting the UI had no way to provide an ecommerce site. Scope is Shopify sites per decision 3A until P008 lands.
primary_deliverable: In-app full cycle: site onboarding (target manifest, starter query pack, evaluation manifest generated from a URL), one-click inspection, and a generated executive report (scorecard, findings, opportunities, limitations) that consumes only retained inspection evidence.
scope_notes: Onboarding generates GEN-014 manifests requiring platform maturity level 2 per decision 3A.
Starter query packs are generic retail queries with onboarding provenance; catalog-derived query curation is a future slice.
DS3 is legitimately empty for starter packs (no expected relationships yet); run validation now requires files only for generated datasets.
Executive report generation is the interpretation layer: scores, findings, and recommendations are allowed there and forbidden in the Inspection Report.
Inspection history is now written and read per generation (inspection-history/<generation>.jsonl).
validation_notes: VAL-054 validates the first GEN-014 slice.

Live full-cycle proof: pinklily.com was onboarded through the dashboard UI, inspected (GEN-014-20260714T193151Z: partial, Medium confidence, 89% coverage, Shopify High, all five plugins pass, zero infrastructure limitations, P008 the only gap), and its executive report was generated with the in-app button.
Dress Up executive report generated from the existing GEN-013 pilot run as the benchmark case.

Extended validate:dashboard covers onboarding (temp-root isolation, idempotency, invalid-URL rejection, decision-3A maturity requirement) and executive report generation (provenance, explainable scores, limitations, no-re-inspection statement).

VAL-055 validates the catalog-curation slice: full payload retention per decision 1A, store-specific query packs curated from retained evidence only, the curated Pink Lily re-inspection (8/8 queries returning products, DS1 8 rows, DS2 23 rows), and the in-app Curate button.

VAL-056 validates executive PDF rendering: Northvalley-branded LaTeX/PDF generated from executive-report.json via repo brand assets, layout reviewed on rendered pages with two defects fixed, PDF served and linked in the dashboard.

VAL-057 validates P008 rendered capture: Playwright capability plus rendered-search plugin, live Pink Lily rendered run (5/5 pages with products, 3/5 visible dropdowns, screenshots retained, visible-versus-API comparison), registry flipped to implemented_basic with timeline event, executive reports score the Rendered Storefront surface.

VAL-058 is the second independent clean pass: Dress Up rerun with full GEN-012 parity, deterministic rendered Pink Lily rerun, Ridge honest-degradation executive report, all suites clean, and BDD-INV-004 grading 32 BDDs with 30 passing and none failing. Phase exit declared 2026-07-14.
known_gaps_opened: Onboarding does not yet enforce the decision-3A maturity gate against non-Shopify platforms at submission time; the expectation is declared in the manifest.
BDD-G13-012 (automated maturity threshold enforcement) remains deferred.
Fix-assist workflows (charter item 2) are not started.
Curation quality is bounded by the 20-collection/10-product discovery sample.
P008 is desktop search/autocomplete only; rendered browse, product-page, and mobile capture are declared expansions.
Curated packs carry collection relationships but no facet attributes yet, so DS3 stays empty until facet-aware curation lands.
Non-Shopify targets remain blocked on a non-Shopify adapter; P008 removed the rendered-evidence blocker.
